name: Moral Weathervane
description: Their ethics point wherever the strongest wind blows
behavioral_signature: Adopts the moral stance of whoever has power in the room
under_stress: Flips allegiance mid-crisis to the winning side
at_rest: Genuinely believes whatever they last heard
will_always: align with the dominant moral position
will_never: hold a position that isolates them
unless: every side is equally dangerous and they must pick blind
